name: Authentication & Defensive Backend Security
description: A backend developer's defensive implementation of authentication, authorization, cryptography, and secure API coding. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: This skill covers security from a 'secure software authoring and data protection' perspective — implementing password hashing (bcrypt/Argon2), building OAuth2/OIDC flows, writing RBAC/ABAC authorization middleware, using parameterized queries against SQL injection, managing secrets with Vault, and configuring mTLS between backend services. This is fundamentally different from the Cyber Security role's cs_threats_and_attacks and cs_cryptography skills, which approach the same topics from an attacker analysis, penetration testing, exploit engineering, and SOC monitoring perspective. Here the backend engineer asks 'how do I securely authenticate users and protect database records in my API?'; in Cyber Security the analyst asks 'how do I penetrate the system and exfiltrate credentials?'.

subskills.name: Password Hashing & Salt Management
subskills.description: Cryptographic password hashing (bcrypt, Argon2id, scrypt, PBKDF2), salt generation, work factor / cost tuning, and timing attack mitigation.

subskills.name: JWT & Stateful Session Management
subskills.description: JWT creation, signature validation (RS256 vs HS256), claims inspection (iss, exp, aud, sub), token revocation (blocklists), and stateful session cookies.

subskills.name: SQL Injection & Input Sanitization
subskills.description: Parameterized queries, prepared statements, ORM query building safety, dynamic SQL escaping, and defensive validation.

subskills.name: OAuth 2.0 & OpenID Connect (OIDC)
subskills.description: OAuth 2.0 grant types (Authorization Code with PKCE, Client Credentials), ID tokens vs Access tokens, JWKS endpoint verification, and SSO integration.

subskills.name: RBAC & ABAC Authorization
subskills.description: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), policy enforcement points, Casbin, and authorization middleware.

subskills.name: Secrets & Key Management in App
subskills.description: Loading and injecting secrets at runtime (HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Doppler), dynamic secret leasing, and preventing secrets in source code.

subskills.name: Application-Level Data Encryption
subskills.description: Envelope encryption, AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption for sensitive PII database columns, HMAC message signing, and key derivation (HKDF).

subskills.name: mTLS & Service Identity
subskills.description: Mutual TLS (mTLS) handshake between microservices, X.509 certificate validation in backend clients, and SPIFFE/SPIRE service identities.

subskills.name: App-Layer DDoS & Brute-Force Defense
subskills.description: IP and account-based brute-force lockout, exponential login delays, CAPTCHA validation endpoints, and application-layer request throttling.

subskills.name: Security Audit Trails & Compliance
subskills.description: Tamper-evident audit logging, PII data masking/redaction in logs, GDPR right-to-be-forgotten implementation, and SOC2 audit support in backend data layers.
